ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (7) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Мир» (mir) is 'the world' in Lamennais's Johannine sense throughout, and «сила и себялюбие» (sila i sebyalyubiye) 'force and self-love'. «Общий отец» (obshchiy otets, 'the common father') stays lowercase as printed; «человекоубийца от начала» (chelovekoubiytsa ot nachala) is 'a murderer from the beginning' (John 8:44), rendered from the Russian.
